title: Shiraishi An — Dressed In Pure White〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness!

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Everyone, here's to a job well done!
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Airi, Shizuku, Kohane & An
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line: I'm so glad we managed to get through our shoot. We even managed to take some wonderful photos.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Yes, we did! An, everyone, thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm glad things turned out well too.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (For a moment there, I tensed up trying to force myself to be a “real bride”.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Luckily, Shizuku, Kohane and the others were there to help me overcome that. Plus, I had fun being a bride in a way that actually suits me.)

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we have to get to our other gig soon, so if you'll excuse us.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: We already took care of the bill, so please stay as long as you like! Again, thank you very much for today!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you as well!
It's not every day that you get to wear a wedding dress and it was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It really was! Thank you very much, Ms. Kawasaki.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
You're very welcome!
Thank you both as well, Shizuku, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course. I'm glad we could be of service.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I really hope you do well in that contest!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Anyway, we'll see you later!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, how about we stay and hang out a bit longer?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Now, what's left? I guess I should let my dad know that everything went well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, was your dad concerned about how today's shoot would go...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, not exactly. More along the lines of, “Just make sure to do things right since you've accepted.” It's sort of his way of saying that I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. He seems like a wonderful parent.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm so jealous, An.
My dad hardly ever listens to anything I say.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! But you mean the world to your dad! What do you mean he doesn't listen?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The thing is... I told him that I was going to play a bridesmaid, but he misheard me and thought that I was going to be the bride.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I know how this one goes. The overbearing dad and his little girl...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It just means he cares about you just that much, no?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I mean, I understand how he feels...
And I really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But he went as far as saying, “If you wear a wedding dress before your actual wedding, you're going to push back when you get married.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And he followed that up with, “But I don't mind waiting longer for you to get married, so I say go have a ball.” That was when my mom got mad at him...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. I didn't know that.
I can totally see your dad panicking after that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. In my case, I'm not a parent, but I can certainly empathize.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If I ever saw Shii in a wedding dress, I'm not sure what I'd do with myself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, what are you going on about...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But it'd be so sad to see Shii be taken away by someone as their bride...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, if they live with us, then that wouldn't be an issue.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You might end up being a bigger nuisance than most mothers-in-law.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which, Airi, did you and Shizuku tell your families that you'd be models for this shoot?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I did.
But they said, “Have fun,” and, “Bring back some nice photos,” like it was just business as usual.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, I told them that I'd be working, so that may've been why.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because your family knows that you always do your best when it comes to work.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
That's so cool! They really believe in you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Y-You think so?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What about you, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I told my family as well.
My mom said, “Have fun.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? That means she must also believe in you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's incredible.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hang on... Does my dad act the way he does because he doesn't really believe in me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? I think your dad believes in you plenty, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If he didn't, he'd still probably be against you performing in live events the way we do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, your dad was against you doing that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. Initially, he was convinced that live houses were scary and dangerous places...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, in order to unravel that perception, we invited him to come see us perform in an event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, after seeing Kohane kicking butt, he decided to give us his blessing and support us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's so nice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm glad he understands now.
Although, his level of concern for me does become a problem sometimes...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course he's concerned. You're always gonna be his little girl.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Now I kinda want to see my dad fall into a state of total panic like yours did, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What? I can't even imagine him doing that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No problem!
What if I told him that I got a boyfriend or something next time?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, no teasing your parents just because you wanna see how they react.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, point taken. Oh well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.
